chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from his uncle Ja'far ibn Sama'ah, from Muthanna, from Abdul-Malik ibn A'yn, from one of the two (Imams) (peace be upon them), who said:
The women have nothing from the houses and the real estate.
ai.seo_question: Do women inherit from real estate in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi articulates the principle of gender-specific inheritance shares, specifically noting that women do not inherit from real estate (houses and land) in the context of the estate being discussed. It reflects the broader Shia jurisprudential understanding of the Quranic verses on inheritance, where the male share is typically double that of the female, emphasizing the financial responsibility (nafaqah) placed on men. This ruling is often contextualized within the specific distribution of assets among heirs rather than a total exclusion of women from inheritance.
